data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Faro was the name of a goddess who presided over travel, journeys, and roads. Her name means 'far' or 'journey'. The name Faro carries the meaning “Far Traveler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Faro usually hope their child will grow to embody far traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
